exchange.name: Coinmotion
exchange.note: Finnish broker. Public rates include EUR and SEK. There is no last-trade field, so last is null. bid is the buy field (the price Coinmotion pays for the asset) and ask is the sell field (the price Coinmotion charges). Pairs quoted in BTC or USDC are left out. The response sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
